notes.title: Demo Tournament on The Standard (LIVE!!!)
notes.content:
Hello! 

We are hosting an in game Tournament!

This is a timed Match Mode that will put you up against the best of the best! 
It is easy to participate, you just need to play 3 matches on the Standard during the specified time period.
Go up to the Starter and select Tournament match to play your matches. You can play them 1 by 1 at any pace you like as long as you complete all 3 by the tournament end Date & Time. 

It starts 3/7 at 12pm UTC and ends 3/120 at 12pm UTC. 

The winner will get an exclusive in game item in the Early Access version of the game! 

Good luck and have fun! 

- Arne

notes.title: V0.6.04 - Lineup Grid Added!
notes.content:
[h3]V0.6.04 - Demo Patch 4 - Fixes And Game Improvements[/h3]
[b]Lineup Grid[/b]
Added a grid that shows when lining up
- Provides better visualization of ground slopes
- Added Options for customizing : Set color, Transparency or disable
-- Access in : Start > Player Settings > Input Settings > Golf Settings (page)

[b]Lineup Hide Trajectory Option[/b]
Added option to turn off Lineup Line visualization
- When Off, will still show final position and fake putt ball
-- Just removes the visual line showing path
-- Access in : Start > Player Settings > Input Settings > Golf Settings (page)

[b]Tutorial Bug Fix[/b]
Drinking soda too quickly at vending machine caused locked state
- Should be prevented now

notes.title: V0.6.03 - Tutorial Upgrade, 8 Player Rooms, Collision improvements
notes.content:
Late post, Update live as of 3/1/2025

[h3]V0.6.03 - Demo Patch 3 (Tutorial Revamp) Out now.[/h3]
[b]Tutorial[/b]
- Reduced time to complete by 5 minutes or so
- Much less dialog
- Option for player to press "Next" for self pacing
- Now presented in Sections which save between each
- Can go back redo specific sections as desired

[b]Room Capacity to 8 Player[/b]
- Untested! But requested by a couple players
- Online Rooms now set to 8 Player max
- Could work or not work but shouldn't be too far from fixing it so it does work if it does not.

[b]Improved Collisions[/b]
- Networked games faced issue where plater would place ball and end up in bad state
- Removed Collisions while doing Item Actions (placing ball, consuming items, etc)
-- Hopefully that improves the frequency of this issue occurring.

notes.title: Demo Update V0.6.02 - Bug fixes and QOL Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]V0.6.02 Update List[/h1]

Global Leaderboards
[list]
[*] Now show your Steam Username instead of local Character (Use local leaderboard to identify which character it was)

[/list]
Player Settings for Golfer
[list]
[*] Now properly saving and loading your custom settings
[*] Added a Reset to Default Button
[/list]

Golf Modifiers for Match Play now an Option
[list]
[*] Added an Option at Starter to turn off Skill modifiers when playing a match
[*] Playing with Modifiers disabled will not Publish Score to Global Leaderboard
[*] Playing with Modifiers disabled will reset your characters current modifiers
[*] Playing with Modifiers disabled will cause Consumables to not apply their effects
[/list]

Fixed Client/Host Disconnection issues
[list]
[*] Client now cleanly disconnects from Host when both quitting server and when host ends game mode
[*] Hose now cleanly handles Client leaving game room and also host ending game room
[*] Client now can disconnect and reconnect or join new room without requiring restart
[/list]

Changed Fullscreen from checkbox to list of options with Borderless now an option
[list]
[*] Choose from Windowed, Borderless or Exclusive Fullscreen options
[/list]

Fixed Bug for Steam Achievement of Starring all maps causing lockup

Improved Golfer Start Menu functionality
[list]
[*] Some bugginess has been resolved
[/list]

Fixed Changing maps while menu open
[list]
[*] Now properly resetting character and closing open menus
[/list]

notes.title: V0.6.01 - First Demo Patch
notes.content:
V0.6.01 - Released
We have provided a patch to address some issues found by players so far.

Some players experienced game freezes. 
- This seemed to commonly occur when starting to lineup with the ball
- More frequently happened to MK players but also to Controller players
- We have found a cause and have implemented a fix.
Tutorial had a couple bugs preventing users from being able to complete it.
- Force field at hole would not go down (fixed)
- Skill menu would lock up when playing the hole (fixed)
Leader boards were only showing Top 9 Scores
- Now properly showing the Top 10

Thank you everyone playing the game! And thank you for being patient to those that have experienced issues with the game.

If you still experience freezing or other types of crashes, please reach out to use on Discord so we can get it fixed ASAP. The more info we can get about what is causing the issue, the sooner we can get it fixed!

Thank you everyone,
Arne
